description: Seed dataset for evaluating the council against baseline single-model answers. There is no single 'correct' answer for a decision prompt, so this is scored on process quality (see run_eval.py: latency, council size chosen, agreement/confidence scores, whether debate ran) rather than exact-match correctness. Extend this file with prompts representative of your real users before drawing conclusions.

cases.prompt: Our monolith's deploy takes 40 minutes and a bad deploy takes down the whole app. Should we split it into microservices now, or fix the deploy pipeline first?
We can spend $40k on paid ads this quarter or hire a second sales rep. Which gets us to our revenue target faster?
A partner wants read access to our user database for an integration. Should we grant direct DB access or build an API layer first?
We need to lay off 8% of the team next month. How and when should we communicate this internally?
Should I take the job offer or stay at my current company?
